input.context: Models, dependencies and panel jobs share one receipt issue. The panel must compare with its previous panel receipt even if a model receipt was posted more recently.

excerpts.text:
- name: Fetch the previous run receipt
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p .upkeep
          touch .upkeep/previous-receipt.md
          note="$(gh issue list --repo "$GH_REPO" --state all --search '"Hosted upkeep receipts" in:title' --json number,title --jq '.[] | select(.title == "Hosted upkeep receipts") | .number' | head -n 1)"
          if [[ -n "$note" ]]; then
            gh issue view "$note" --repo "$GH_REPO" --json body,comments --jq 'if (.comments | length) == 0 then .body else .comments[-1].body end' >> .upkeep/previous-receipt.md
          fi

defects.claim: Selecting the latest receipt without filtering its upkeep brief supplies another job’s baseline to the weekly panel.
